name: flasherx
description: FlasherX flash layer (FlashTxx.c/h) by Joe Pasquariello et al., public domain — in-application firmware update for Teensy 4.1: stage a new image in free flash above the running program, verify it, copy it over the program from RAM and reboot. Vendored from github.com/joepasquariello/FlasherX @ 9d5067b with two documented patches (FLASH_RESERVE = 256 KB for the Teensyduino EEPROM emulation; page-sized writes in flash_move). The Intel-HEX parser is NOT vendored — the tuner-controller has its own, unit-tested one in app/ota.cpp.
